$comment: scope-guard config. Edit this, never the .mjs. Validate: node .claude/hooks/scope-guard.mjs --check ; try: --explain <agent|-> write <path> | shell "<cmd>" ; table: --matrix. Entry matching: 'dir/' = prefix, 'stem*' = stem, else exact file. Agents not listed anywhere are DENIED (fail-closed). The parent session (no agent) is allowed except global_deny and closed gates.

global_deny.why: generated (Expo CNG prebuild / package manager) — never hand-edited, by anyone

gates.why: Phase 1 gate — product code allowed once canon 01-05 were LOCKED

canon.why: Canon changes go through a written proposal and a human decision (propose-design-change).

scrum-master.why: backlog, team definitions, hooks config, docs hygiene; production code belongs to the owning dev, canon to doc-steward

docs-janitor.why: moves non-canon docs byte for byte; never canon, never code

doc-steward.why: canonical docs and the money-rules cache

workflow-subagent.why: generic identity the Workflow tool's runner presents to the hook for an ad-hoc agent() call with no .claude/agents/<name>.md of its own (field-discovered, three projects independently). Deliberately narrower than any named role: a sandbox for probes and QA logs only, never production code, never docs/ — a lens that turns out to need more runs as a real named Agent instead. --check will warn 'workflow-subagent has no .claude/agents/workflow-subagent.md' — that warning is expected and correct; do not silence it by creating a matching persona file.
